reviews.t: Extremely kind folks here! I just stopped by because they are offering supplies (due to the hurricane). This Church gave us some delicious beef tacos, it's so nice to eat a hot meal! They also gave us a case of bottled water. They have lots of other supplies available too, including baby supplies and clothes. Very generous. These people deserve a shout-out. THANK YOU, LANDMARK MISSIONARY BAPTIST CHURCH! ❤️

People are excited to meet you and for you to come back. It's a little church believes that Jesus was born of a virgin and He was beaten, spat on, and more. Then they (the Jews) made a crown of thorns. They pressed the thorns hard into His head. There was two other men with him that hang on the crosses. Christ had to carry His own. Once there the Jews hung them up to die a painful death. He died for us, so we wouldn't have to go to Hell. When He was checked to see if He was dead, they put Him in a borrowed tomb. He arose from the dead three days later. He went through Hell to get the keys of death, Hell and the grave. Praise the Lord. Please forgive the mistakes I made. There's more to the story. Come and hear it.
This is where a person can hear 'THE WORD' (King James Bible) from a man that has been called from GOD. There's southern gospel singing in congragational atmosphere. Everyone is welcome!
Go there we for good preaching,, singing, fellowship. Down home atmosphere. Love it!
Love this church. Always inviting and real.
